acceptance_criteria.statement: The complete autonomous operating loop is implemented and passes every ordered qualification stage through released post-release Completion Gate.

definition_of_done: All six vertical slices are integrated and behaviorally verified.
The golden journey is local-real and uses isolated real Git worktrees.
Authorized live integrations and real worker dispatch are qualified or remain explicit blockers.
Windows, recovery, 24-hour, 72-hour, release, and post-release gates pass.
The deterministic Completion Gate reports COMPLETE without mocks or lower-environment substitution.
description: Deliver and qualify the continuously operating local-first Autonomy Runtime from intake through next-work continuation, including autonomous BLOCKED_EXTERNAL rechecks, partial continuation, and truthful Command Center operation.
exclusions: No completion from class, schema, plan, mock, deterministic simulation, generated evidence, or local preview existence.
Unavailable credentials and environments remain blockers.
objective: Autonomous Runtime Integration and Unattended Qualification
observability_impact: Expose durable loop, lane, incident, integration, budget, qualification, and Completion Gate state.
rationale: The original source defines the perpetual autonomous engineering loop as the central product outcome, which the previous compiled model omitted.
rollback_recovery_consideration: Preserve the last verified product model and runtime checkpoint; roll back one cohesive slice without rewriting historical evidence.
scope: Deliver and qualify the complete continuous autonomous product outcome.
security_impact: Controls autonomous authority, credentials, external mutations, worker isolation, and completion claims.
title: Autonomous Runtime Integration and Unattended Qualification
